steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: A short setup to get this app ready. Nothing here is required; you can close it and come back later.

steps.title: Which example data do you want?
steps.body: Example data fills the lists, detail pages and dashboards, so you see the app working straight away. Each set shows one kind of organisation. Pick "None" on a production install.

steps.title: Load the example data
steps.body: Loads the set you picked. It is sample data, and running it twice adds nothing. You can remove it again at the end of this wizard.

steps.title: What kind of organisation is this?
steps.body: Pick the one that fits best. The app shows the menus that fit it. You can change it later under App settings.

steps.title: Remove the example data
steps.body: This only runs when you click the button. It moves the example set you loaded to the trash and keeps everything you made yourself. You can come back to it later.

store._note: The course store (lesson-sharing-via-store-plane). Learniq ships its own Controller\StoreController, so OpenRegister's generic store controller is not bound for learniq and this block documents the store rather than configuring it: search and resolve run through OpenRegister's GenericStoreService with CourseStoreDescriptor (schema shared-course-package in register learniq of the configured registry; its CARD_FIELDS are the one list of card fields, so none are repeated here); install imports a shared course as a copy through CoursePackageImportService; publish runs the sharing gate first. `installable` is empty on purpose: the engine's generic installer never writes for learniq. The configuration-set types this block used to declare never had a route in learniq; configuration sets stay installable through OpenRegister's own configuration import.

pages.title: Store

config.title: Store
config.description: Find courses other schools share and install your own copy. Every course here carries an open licence and the name of its maker.

pages._note: ADR-114 Decision 4 / ADR-080, lesson-sharing-via-store-plane. CnStorePage calls learniq's own StoreController: search through OpenRegister's store plane, install as a copy through CoursePackageImportService. store-rights-for-teachers (D27): src/main.js writes canInstall and canPublish from the storeAccess initial state into this config, and publishRoute sends Publish to the export screen, where the sharing gate runs; a CnStorePage without those props (before nextcloud-vue #1268 is released) keeps Install admin-only. With no registry configured the page says so and makes no network call.

ADR-112 / ADR-114 Decision 3. NOTHING here is invented and nothing is relocated: all nine pages already existed as routes with NO menu entry at all, reachable only by someone who already knew the URL. Carding them GIVES an entry point rather than moving one. Two neighbouring orphans are deliberately NOT carded, because a gate finding is a question rather than an instruction: AuditPackExport (/compliance/export) BUILDS an export, and EngagementRiskThresholds (/progress/engagement-thresholds) CONFIGURES the thresholds that produce the flags. Both are things you do, not readings, and ADR-097 keeps work in the main navigation. The report periods, report cards, conference reports and course-package import reports already have menu entries and stay there: ADR-112 forbids a report being BOTH a card and an entry, not being an entry.

config._note: An xAPI Statement is an immutable learning-experience event (actor, verb, object, result, context, timestamp, authority) — a log/technical archetype. Body leads with the statement data including the full actor/verb/object/result JSON (wide, 12-col, single column for readability) and a Related panel resolving the linked course/lesson. NO comms leaves, NO child rosters — an xAPI statement is a write-once event. Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail.

pages.title: School-year rollover
pages._note: Mapping editor for the jaarovergang (school-year-rollover): the "custom view only where a manifest page cannot render it" exception. Proposes a leerjaar-increment default mapping, runs the mandatory side-effect-free preview gate, and triggers the idempotent server-side execution (RolloverExecutionHandler) by transitioning the RolloverPlan to executing.

pages.title: Flows
pages._note: ADR-110 Decision 4: a flow is app-specific, so the authoring surface lives here rather than behind a deep link to another app's list. An ordinary index over the named `flows` source (config.entitySource) rather than the deprecated `flows` page type, reading OpenRegister's one native flow store (ADR-065), scoped to this app by config.app.

pages.title: Flow
pages._note: The shared CnFlowDetail canvas over the same single engine. Controls render in the NC app sidebar (sidebarComponent) so the canvas keeps full width; canvas and sidebar share useFlowStore. The _note claimed this before the field existed, so #/flows/new -- and every #/flows/:id -- rendered a bare canvas with no way to name, describe, trigger or step-edit the flow. Mirrors pipelinq#1490.
